description: DataSet for the paper: "An Intelligent Transportation System to Control Air Pollution and Road Traffic in Cities Integrating CEP and Colored Petri nets is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Gregorio Diaz. These files should be considered as additional material for the paper "An Intelligent Transportation System to Control Air Pollution and Road Traffic in Cities Integrating CEP and Colored Petri nets". Its aim is to show how to reproduce the observed data by using the developed Color Petri Nets. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2018. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
